E4g001-Graphite412KardiaPsalloI.desc:
Kardia Psallo is a peaceful amalgamation of synthesis and recorded audio that combines into a long, drone soundscape.  The sound layers blend together, swell and intermingle to create a slowly changing, complex drone.  The use of various tempos and alterations of metered audio removes the sense of time to present a perspective on eternity.  The name comes from the Greek words kardia and psallo, kardia meaning heart, and psallo, meaning to make melody.

// Release Date
December 2011

This is graphite412's third installment of the peacemaker series.  The 
track slowly builds and climbs its way into a deep, contemplative soundscape filled
with layers of synthesis and familiar, environmental sounds.  It is calm enough
to not be distracting but complex enough to engage active listening.  Dive deeply
into stillness and know Him who is our peace.  This is a rework of the original
version and is much shorter in length.
